instruction.text: Listen to the description of the habitat. Then select the correct picture.

atoms.a: The area of this habitat can be huge, but you won’t find many plants.
During the day it can get very hot but at night the temperature can drop significantly.
Sometimes it doesn’t rain for years in this habitat and, even if it does rain, it is only a little.
This habitat can be very sandy and dry.

trainers.instruction: What is the name of all of these habitats? Select the correct button.
This picture shows a map of the African continent. Select the desert.

correct.text: Well done! This desert is called the Sahara. It is located in Africa and is the biggest hot desert on Earth. From space, most deserts look like a yellow piece of land because they are so dry.

instruction.text: All of these animals live in the desert. First, read the description. Then select the correct animal.

atoms.a: I am a mammal. I have white fur and my long horns make me look a lot taller than I actually am.
I am a reptile. My body has a grey brown colour and I can lose my tail if I get attacked by predators.
I can store fat in my hump. Therefore, I can walk for long distances without drinking or eating and even carry heavy things while doing so.
I have huge furry ears compared to my body size. They help me to cool down my body.

trainers.instruction: These two foxes live in different habitats. Look at the picture and compare the specialisations of their bodies. Then choose the correct answer to fill in the gaps.

atoms.b: The fennec fox has several adaptations in its body to better survive in its extreme ((++habitat city)). Compared to other foxes, they have ((++larger smaller)) ears and thicker fur around their ((++paws tail)).
The fur around their paws prevents them from getting burned when walking on the hot sand, while their large ears help them to ((++lose gain)) heat more easily.
Since their habitat is incredibly hot during the day, the fennec fox ((++rests plays_video_games)) to save energy while the sun is shining. Instead, they hunt for food at ((noon ++night)).
